notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG files this game under the slug "gwent-thronebreaker" (id 244722), which matches the expected slug. StrategyWiki has no page under "Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales" or "Thronebreaker". witcher.fandom.com has the page with about 102 linked pages, mostly other Witcher books, games and shows; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 39 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter. Meve is named only because an achievement description names her; the chapter title assumes she leads the campaign.
